settings.title: AI settings
settings.intro: Choose the provider and model of your calls, see which key they use, and check the connection.
settings.notAllowed: The AI is not available to your account.

personal.title: Your preferences
personal.noProvider: No AI provider is available to you.

preference.notApplied: Your default does not apply now: its model is closed to you, or no key reaches its provider. The app's default applies.
preference.removed: You use the app's default again.

key.user: assigned to you by an admin
key.group: assigned by an admin to the group {group}
key.all: assigned by an admin to everyone
key.none: none: this provider cannot be used
key.noneOptional: none: the server takes calls without a key

token.placeholder: Your own token for this provider
token.saved: Your token ending in {last4} is saved.
token.unused: You saved a token, but an admin does not allow it now: it is not used.
token.help: Kept encrypted on the server: the browser never reads it again.

check.modelMissing: The server answered, but does not list {model}.
check.noKey: No key: this provider cannot be used.

admin.title: Keys
admin.intro: Visible to the AI's admins: who uses which key and which models.
admin.empty: No assignment: everyone uses every model the app enables, with the app's key, and no own token.

assignment.closed: None ticked: the provider is closed to them.
assignment.widens: One user's assignment decides alone: with every model, this user gets them all, though a group of theirs limits them.
assignment.keyKept: Leave it empty to keep the key saved.
assignment.keyNext: Leave it empty to use the next level's key.
assignment.removeKey: Remove the key: the next level's applies
assignment.personalTokens: Its users may use their own token
assignment.personalTokensHelp: Their calls then go through their own account with the provider.

groups.title: Order of the groups
groups.help: A user in several groups gets the assignment of the group highest in this list.
groups.savedNotice: The order of the groups is saved.

write.user: The user's id in the backend

behaviour.title: How the AI works
behaviour.intro: For everyone in the app. The admins change what the app sets, within what it allows; Mapo's rules stay above all.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.help: Added to every prompt after Mapo's rules and the app's, which win where they disagree. Whoever uses the AI reads them in Fill with AI, under What I send to the AI: write nothing they should not read.
instructions.appNone: The app adds no rule here.
instructions.preview: Show the rules the model reads
instructions.previewNote: Mapo's rules, the app's and yours as written, not saved yet. Without the record, the source and the rules the app adds for a request.

rules.title: Verification
rules.help: What a quote of the source must hold for a value to be verified, and go into an empty field by itself. No rule verifies a value without a quote found in the source.
rules.looser: Less prudent than the app's rules or Mapo's defaults: {rules}. More values go into the form by themselves, with less of a quote to prove them.

bareHours.label: An hour alone is a time
bareHours.help: “at 9 pm” written as “at 21” counts, from 13 to 23.

timeZones.label: A time needs its time zone
timeZones.help: A date and time verifies only with the time zone its quote writes.

oneWordQuotes.label: Quotes of one word
oneWordQuotes.help: When a quote of a single word counts.
oneWordQuotes.unique: When the source writes it once

richTextLinks.label: Rich text needs its links
richTextLinks.help: Rich text verifies only when its quote writes the address of each of its links.

soleNumber.label: A number needs a quote of its own
soleNumber.help: “6 stars out of 5” verifies neither number.

secrets.title: Secret fields
secrets.help: A field whose name, or a name around it, holds one of these words, whole, is never filled by the AI.
secrets.placeholder: A word of a field's name, such as vault
secrets.invalid: Letters, digits, spaces, _, - and ., up to 64 characters.

providers.title: Providers
providers.help: Settings of each provider the app enables.
providers.cacheHelp: Keeps the rules and the schema in the provider's cache for a few minutes, never the source: the calls that follow cost less.
providers.fallbacksHelp: A request the model declines for its safety filters goes to a model Anthropic picks, at that model's prices.
providers.notApplied: The app no longer lets admins add models: the ones added do not apply.
providers.modelPlaceholder: A model's id, as the provider lists it
providers.modelNote: Saved only if the provider's server lists it, asked with the key your own calls use. Then assign it in the keys.
providers.cannotAdd: The app lets no admin add models to this provider.

usage.title: Usage
usage.intro: The calls of the period, read from the audit: what was asked never is.
usage.unpriced: {n} calls of models the app gives no price are not in the cost.
usage.truncated: The period has more calls than one reading takes: the figures are of the newest ones.

actions.title: Changes
actions.intro: Who changed the keys and the AI settings, and when. Never a key, an instruction or a word.
actions.truncated: Only the newest 500 changes of the period are listed.
